Title: Collection tracker
Validation.KnownIMDbId: The content is already in the collection.
Validation.MissingKeys: The template is missing the following keys: {keys}
Message.StorageSettings: The storage settings dictate the policies for using browser storage within the application.
Message.IntegrationSettings: The integration settings include the credentials for the external services being used. For example, you can specify the OMDb API key.
Message.SensitiveDataStorage: With local storage, your data will be retained after the session ends. In contrast, with session storage, the affected data (e.g., the OMDb API key) will be deleted when the session concludes.
Message.OMDbApiKey: You could register a free API key at https://www.omdbapi.com/.
Message.AppMode: With the App mode settings, you can restrict modification actions. Basic = read-only, Limited = add-only, Full = add, edit, and delete.
Message.Tags: Please use space for delimiting. Eg: #tag1 tag2 The generated collection item will contain a default #movie or #series type tag.
Message.NewCollectionItemSearch: Search using a title, IMDb ID, or IMDb URL.
Message.MissingImages: The image URL is sourced from the OMDb response and is stored in the markdown content. This setting allows for the possibility of changing the image URL in the background. Using this option, you can refresh any missing images, which will check the availability of all the images in the collection.
Message.FetchBatchSize: The fetch batch size determines the number of items retrieved in a single request during the collection load.
Message.SettingsLock: The settings lock helps prevent accidental changes to the application settings. If it is enabled, you must navigate to the About page and click on the app version ten times to unlock the settings.
Message.AccessTokenSettings: The access token settings allow you to configure the authentication tokens used by the application.
Message.CreateNewAccessToken: You can create a new access token to grant permissions to external applications.
Message.AccessTokenCreated: Here is your new access token. Please copy it now, as it will not be displayed again.
Message.UserSettings: The user settings allow you to make account-related changes. This includes actions such as changing the login token or deleting the account.
Message.NewUserTokenCreated: Here is your new user token. Please copy it now, as it will not be displayed again.
Message.AnimatedBackground: Enable or disable animated background. This setting impacts your network usage because enabling this option will fill the background with poster images from your collection items.
Message.EmptySelectTagsForChart: Please select at least one tag to display the chart.
Message.ParserTemplate: The parser template defines how the collection items are structured. You can use various placeholders to represent different attributes of the collection items.
Message.TemplateRegexps: The template regexps are used to extract specific information from the raw template. Each regexp corresponds to a particular attribute of the collection items.
Message.IMDBIdRegexp: This regexp extracts the IMDb ID from the template.
Message.GenreRegexp: This regexp extracts the genre list from the template.
Message.GenreTokenRegexp: Because the genre is usually a list, it extracts the genres from the raw genre string.
Message.ImageRegexp: This regexp extracts the image URL from the template.
Message.IMDbRateRegexp: This regexp extracts the IMDb rating from the template.
Message.TagsRegexp: This regexp extracts the tags list from the template.
Message.TagTokenRegexp: Because the tags is usually a list, it extracts the tags from the raw tags string.
Message.TitleRegexp: This regexp extracts the title from the template.
Message.YearRegexp: This regexp extracts the year from the template.
Message.TemplateVariables: You can use the following variables in your template: {{Variables}}. The variable names come from the OMDb API response, except for YoutubeQuery and WebQuery. These are only used to generate links for searching trailers or web pages.
Message.PreviewGenerationError: An error occurred while generating the preview. Please check your template and regexps.
Message.RegeneratingTemplates: Regenerating templates, please wait. {count} items remaining
Message.RefreshImages: Refreshing images, please wait. {count} items remaining
Message.RefreshTemplates: Without applying the new template, the stored files on the collection page will not load correctly. This setting enables you to change the template if needed. By using this option, you can regenerate all templates based on the current parser settings.
Message.SearchMode: The search mode determines how the application searches for collection items. Standard mode uses exact matches, while fuzzy mode allows for approximate matches, which can be useful for handling typos or variations in titles. The fuzzy search is limited to short search texts to avoid performance issues.

Confirm.DeleteUser: Do you want to delete the user? The operation will irreversibly remove all associated data.
Confirm.TemplateRegeneration: Do you want to regenerate the templates? This operation will reprocess all collection items based on the current parser settings. That may take a while and you could reach the OMDb rate limit. Please do not refresh or close the page until the process is complete.
Confirm.ImageRefresh: Do you want to refresh images? This operation will reprocess all collection items and refresh the missing images. That may take a while and you could reach the OMDb rate limit. Please do not refresh or close the page until the process is complete.
